source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.27 — general speed limits

en.question: Unless a road sign shows a different limit, what is the general speed limit on a public road in an urban area?
en.explanation: The general limit in an urban area is 60 km/h unless a road traffic sign sets another limit.

af.question: Tensy 'n padteken 'n ander limiet aandui, wat is die algemene spoedgrens op 'n openbare pad in 'n stedelike gebied?
af.explanation: Die algemene limiet in 'n stedelike gebied is 60 km/h tensy 'n padverkeersteken 'n ander limiet bepaal.

xh.question: Ngaphandle kokuba uphawu lwendlela lubonisa omnye umda, ngowuphi umda wesantya oqhelekileyo kwindlela kawonke-wonke kummandla wedolophu?
xh.explanation: Umda oqhelekileyo kummandla wedolophu yi-60 km/h ngaphandle kokuba uphawu lwendlela lubeka omnye umda.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.27 — general speed limits

en.question: What is the general speed limit on a public road outside an urban area when it is not a freeway and no other limit is shown?
en.explanation: Unless a road sign shows another limit, the general speed limit on a non-freeway public road outside an urban area is 100 km/h.

af.question: Wat is die algemene spoedgrens op 'n openbare pad buite 'n stedelike gebied wanneer dit nie 'n snelweg is nie en geen ander grens aangedui word nie?
af.explanation: Tensy 'n padteken 'n ander grens aandui, is die algemene spoedgrens op 'n openbare pad buite 'n stedelike gebied wat nie 'n snelweg is nie 100 km/h.

xh.question: Ngowuphi umda wesantya oqhelekileyo kwindlela kawonke-wonke engaphandle kwendawo yasezidolophini xa ingengohola wendlela kwaye kungekho omnye umda obonisiweyo?
xh.explanation: Ngaphandle kokuba uphawu lubonisa omnye umda, umda oqhelekileyo kwindlela kawonke-wonke engaphandle kwendawo yasezidolophini nengengohola wendlela yi-100 km/h.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.27 — general speed limits

en.question: What is the general speed limit on a freeway when no lower limit is shown?
en.explanation: Unless a lower speed limit is shown by a road sign, the general speed limit on a freeway is 120 km/h.

af.question: Wat is die algemene spoedgrens op 'n snelweg wanneer geen laer grens aangedui word nie?
af.explanation: Tensy 'n laer spoedgrens deur 'n padteken aangedui word, is die algemene spoedgrens op 'n snelweg 120 km/h.

xh.question: Ngowuphi umda wesantya oqhelekileyo kuhola wendlela xa kungekho mda osezantsi obonisiweyo?
xh.explanation: Ngaphandle kokuba uphawu lwendlela lubonisa umda osezantsi, umda oqhelekileyo kuhola wendlela yi-120 km/h.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.1.2 — light and heavy motor vehicle lamps

en.question: When must a light or heavy motor vehicle normally have its headlamps, rear lamps and number-plate lamps switched on?
options: Between sunset and sunrise, and when visibility is poor
en.explanation: These lamps must be on between sunset and sunrise and also when poor light or weather makes people and vehicles difficult to see.

af.question: Wanneer moet 'n ligte of swaar motorvoertuig gewoonlik sy hoofligte, agterligte en nommerplaatligte aanskakel?
options: Tussen sonsondergang en sonsopkoms, en wanneer sig swak is
af.explanation: Hierdie ligte moet tussen sonsondergang en sonsopkoms aan wees, en ook wanneer swak lig of weer mense en voertuie moeilik sigbaar maak.

xh.question: Kufuneka nini isithuthi esilula okanye esinzima sikhanyise izibane zangaphambili, zangasemva nezepheyiti yenombolo?
options: Phakathi kokutshona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga, naxa ukubona kungacacanga
xh.explanation: Ezi zibane kufuneka zikhanyiswe phakathi kokutshona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga, kwanaxa ukukhanya okanye imozulu yenza abantu nezithuthi kube nzima ukuzibona.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.1.1 — motorcycles

en.question: When riding a motorcycle on a public road, when should the headlamp be switched on?
en.explanation: The motorcycle headlamp must be lit while riding on a public road during both day and night.

af.question: Wanneer jy met 'n motorfiets op 'n openbare pad ry, wanneer moet die hooflig aangeskakel wees?
af.explanation: Die motorfiets se hooflig moet brand terwyl jy op 'n openbare pad ry, bedags sowel as snags.

xh.question: Xa ukhwele isithuthuthu kwindlela kawonke-wonke, kufuneka isibane sangaphambili sikhanyiswe nini?
xh.explanation: Isibane sangaphambili sesithuthuthu kufuneka sikhanyiswe xa usihamba kwindlela kawonke-wonke emini nasebusuku.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.2 — main beam

en.question: When should you dip your main-beam headlights?
options: For oncoming traffic and when following another vehicle
Only when entering a parking area
en.explanation: The learner manual says to dip the main beam for oncoming traffic and when following another vehicle.

af.question: Wanneer moet jy jou helder hoofligte verdof?
options: Vir aankomende verkeer en wanneer jy 'n ander voertuig volg
Slegs wanneer jy stadiger as 60 km/h ry
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê jy moet die helder ligte verdof vir aankomende verkeer en wanneer jy 'n ander voertuig volg.

xh.question: Kufuneka uzithobe nini izibane zakho eziphezulu?
options: Xa kukho izithuthi eziza ngakuwe naxa ulandela esinye isithuthi
Kuphela xa uqhuba ngaphantsi kwe-60 km/h
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi izibane eziphezulu mazithotywe xa kukho izithuthi eziza ngakuwe naxa ulandela esinye isithuthi.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.17 — seat belts

en.question: If rear-seat seat belts are fitted, what must rear-seat passengers do while the vehicle is being driven?
en.explanation: Where rear-seat belts are fitted, rear-seat passengers must wear them while the vehicle is being driven.

af.question: As veiligheidsgordels op die agtersitplekke aangebring is, wat moet passasiers agter doen terwyl die voertuig bestuur word?
af.explanation: Waar agtersitplek-veiligheidsgordels aangebring is, moet passasiers dit dra terwyl die voertuig bestuur word.

xh.question: Ukuba amabhanti okhuseleko afakwe kwizihlalo zangasemva, kufuneka benze ntoni abakhweli basemva xa isithuthi siqhutywa?
xh.explanation: Xa amabhanti okhuseleko afakwe kwizihlalo zangasemva, abakhweli basemva kufuneka bawabhinqe xa isithuthi siqhutywa.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.17.1 — children

en.question: If an appropriate child restraint is available for a child in a motor vehicle, what should the driver ensure?
options: The child uses the child restraint
The child sits in the front seat
The child holds the seat belt without fastening it
en.explanation: The driver must ensure that a child uses an appropriate child restraint when one is available.

af.question: As 'n geskikte kinderbeveiliging vir 'n kind in 'n motorvoertuig beskikbaar is, wat moet die bestuurder verseker?
options: Dat die kind die kinderbeveiliging gebruik
Dat die kind op die voorste sitplek sit
Dat die kind die veiligheidsgordel vashou sonder om dit vas te maak
af.explanation: Die bestuurder moet verseker dat 'n kind 'n geskikte kinderbeveiliging gebruik wanneer een beskikbaar is.

xh.question: Ukuba kukho isixhobo esifanelekileyo sokhuseleko lomntwana kwisithuthi, kufuneka umqhubi aqinisekise ntoni?
xh.explanation: Umqhubi kufuneka aqinisekise ukuba umntwana usebenzisa isixhobo esifanelekileyo sokhuseleko xa sikhona.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.45 — overtaking/passing

en.question: When overtaking another vehicle travelling in the same direction, what is the normal side to pass on?
options: The right, at a safe distance
en.explanation: The normal rule is to pass on the right at a safe distance and return left only when safely clear.

af.question: Wanneer jy 'n ander voertuig verbysteek wat in dieselfde rigting ry, aan watter kant moet jy normaalweg verbygaan?
options: Enige kant sonder om te kyk
af.explanation: Die normale reël is om regs op 'n veilige afstand verby te gaan en eers links terug te beweeg wanneer dit veilig is.

xh.question: Xa udlula esinye isithuthi esihamba kwicala elifanayo, ngeliphi icala oqhele ukudlula kulo?
xh.explanation: Umgaqo oqhelekileyo kukudlula ngasekunene ugcine umgama okhuselekileyo, uze ubuyele ngasekhohlo kuphela xa kukhuselekile.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.45 — overtaking/passing

en.question: May you exceed the speed limit just because you are overtaking another vehicle?
en.explanation: Overtaking does not allow a driver or rider to exceed the applicable speed limit.

af.question: Mag jy die spoedgrens oorskry net omdat jy 'n ander voertuig verbysteek?
af.explanation: Verbysteek laat nie 'n bestuurder of ryer toe om die toepaslike spoedgrens te oorskry nie.

xh.question: Ungawugqitha umda wesantya kuba nje udlula esinye isithuthi?
xh.explanation: Ukudlula esinye isithuthi akumvumeli umqhubi okanye umkhweli wesithuthuthu ukuba agqithe umda wesantya osebenzayo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.49 — minimum following distance for light motor vehicles and motorcycles

en.question: What minimum following time should a light motor vehicle driver or motorcycle rider normally keep behind the vehicle ahead?
en.explanation: The learner manual states a minimum 2-second following distance for light motor vehicles and motorcycles.

af.question: Watter minimum volgtyd moet 'n bestuurder van 'n ligte motorvoertuig of 'n motorfietsryer normaalweg agter die voertuig voor hou?
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal 'n minimum volgafstand van 2 sekondes vir ligte motorvoertuie en motorfietse.

xh.question: Leliphi ixesha elincinane lokulandela ekufuneka umqhubi wesithuthi esilula okanye umkhweli wesithuthuthu aligcine emva kwesithuthi esingaphambili?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza umgama wokulandela ubuncinane wemizuzwana emi-2 kwizithuthi ezilula nakwizithuthuthu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.49 — following distance must be increased in adverse conditions

en.question: What should you do with your following distance when it is raining, the road is slippery or visibility is poor?
en.explanation: The learner manual says the following distance should be increased in adverse conditions such as rain, slippery roads or poor visibility.

af.question: Wat moet jy met jou volgafstand doen wanneer dit reën, die pad glad is of sig swak is?
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê die volgafstand moet vergroot word in ongunstige toestande soos reën, gladde paaie of swak sig.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni ngomgama wakho wokulandela xa kunetha, indlela imtyibilizi okanye ukubona kungacacanga?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi umgama wokulandela mawonyuswe kwiimeko ezimbi ezifana nemvula, indlela emtyibilizi okanye ukubona okungacacanga.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.47 — parking within an urban area: not within 5 metres of an intersection

en.question: In an urban area, may you park a vehicle on the roadway within 5 metres of an intersection?
options: Yes, if the hazard lights are on
en.explanation: The learner manual states that you may not park on the roadway within 5 metres of an intersection in an urban area.

af.question: Mag jy in 'n stedelike gebied 'n voertuig op die rybaan binne 5 meter van 'n kruising parkeer?
options: Ja, as die noodligte aan is
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal dat jy nie in 'n stedelike gebied binne 5 meter van 'n kruising op die rybaan mag parkeer nie.

xh.question: Kummandla wedolophu, ngaba ungapaka isithuthi endleleni ngaphakathi kweemitha ezi-5 ukusuka kwisiphambuka?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuba akuvumelekanga ukupaka endleleni ngaphakathi kweemitha ezi-5 ukusuka kwisiphambuka kummandla wedolophu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.47 — no parking within 9 metres of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing in an urban area

en.question: In an urban area, may you park on the roadway within 9 metres before a pedestrian crossing?
options: Yes, if no pedestrians are present
Yes, for less than five minutes
en.explanation: The learner manual states that you may not park on the roadway within 9 metres of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing in an urban area.

af.question: Mag jy in 'n stedelike gebied op die rybaan binne 9 meter voor 'n voetgangeroorgang parkeer?
options: Ja, as daar geen voetgangers is nie
Ja, vir minder as vyf minute
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal dat jy nie op die rybaan binne 9 meter aan die naderingskant van 'n voetgangeroorgang in 'n stedelike gebied mag parkeer nie.

xh.question: Kummandla wedolophu, ngaba ungapaka endleleni ngaphakathi kweemitha ezi-9 phambi kwendawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuba akuvumelekanga ukupaka endleleni ngaphakathi kweemitha ezi-9 kwicala lokusondela kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo kummandla wedolophu.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.47 — no parking on the same side within 1.5 metres on either side of a fire hydrant

en.question: May you park on the same side of the road within 1.5 metres of a fire hydrant?
options: Yes, if the engine is left running
en.explanation: The learner manual says you may not park on the same side of the road within 1.5 metres on either side of a fire hydrant.

af.question: Mag jy aan dieselfde kant van die pad binne 1,5 meter van 'n brandkraan parkeer?
options: Ja, as die enjin aan bly
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê jy mag nie aan dieselfde kant van die pad binne 1,5 meter aan weerskante van 'n brandkraan parkeer nie.

xh.question: Ngaba ungapaka kwicala elinye lendlela ngaphakathi kweemitha ezi-1,5 ukusuka kwisicimi-manzi somlilo?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi akuvumelekanga ukupaka kwicala elinye lendlela ngaphakathi kweemitha ezi-1,5 macala omabini kwisicimi-manzi somlilo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road — traffic circle / junction rule: yield to vehicular traffic approaching from the right unless controlled otherwise

en.question: At a traffic circle with no traffic officer or sign giving a different instruction, which traffic should you normally yield to?
options: Traffic approaching from your left only
en.explanation: At an uncontrolled traffic circle, the learner manual says to yield to vehicular traffic approaching from the right unless another instruction applies.

af.question: By 'n verkeersirkel sonder 'n verkeersbeampte of teken wat 'n ander opdrag gee, aan watter verkeer moet jy normaalweg padgee?
options: Slegs verkeer wat van links nader
af.explanation: By 'n onbeheerde verkeersirkel sê die leerderhandleiding jy moet padgee aan voertuie wat van regs nader, tensy 'n ander opdrag geld.

xh.question: Kwisangqa sezithuthi apho kungekho gosa lezendlela okanye uphawu olunika omnye umyalelo, zeziphi izithuthi oqhele ukuzinika indlela?
xh.explanation: Kwisangqa sezithuthi esingalawulwayo, incwadi yomfundi ithi kufuneka unike indlela kwizithuthi ezisondela ngasekunene ngaphandle kokuba kukho omnye umyalelo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.45 — vehicles must keep left and overtake to the right on a freeway

en.question: On a freeway, what is the normal lane rule for a vehicle?
options: Keep left and overtake to the right
Keep right and overtake to the left
Use any lane without regard to overtaking
en.explanation: The learner manual states that vehicles must keep left and overtake to the right on a freeway.

af.question: Wat is die normale baanreël vir 'n voertuig op 'n snelweg?
options: Hou links en steek regs verby
Hou regs en steek links verby
Gebruik enige baan sonder om op verbysteek te let
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal dat voertuie op 'n snelweg links moet hou en regs moet verbysteek.

xh.question: Ngowuphi umgaqo oqhelekileyo wemizila yesithuthi kuhola wendlela?
options: Sebenzisa nawuphi na umzila ngaphandle kokujonga ukudlula
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuba izithuthi kufuneka zihlale ngasekhohlo zize zidlule ngasekunene kuhola wendlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.45 — when another vehicle wishes to pass: keep near the left edge and do not accelerate until it has passed

en.question: What should you do when you become aware that another vehicle behind wants to overtake you?
options: Keep as near to the left as is safely possible and do not accelerate until it has passed
Move to the right-hand side of the road
en.explanation: The learner manual says to keep safely near the left edge and not accelerate until the overtaking vehicle has passed.

af.question: Wat moet jy doen wanneer jy agterkom dat 'n voertuig agter jou jou wil verbysteek?
options: Hou so veilig moontlik naby die linkerkant en moenie versnel totdat dit verby is nie
Versnel sodat dit nie kan verbygaan nie
Beweeg na die regterkant van die pad
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê jy moet veilig naby die linkerkant hou en nie versnel voordat die verbysteekvoertuig verby is nie.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni xa uqaphela ukuba isithuthi esisemva sifuna ukudlula kuwe?
options: Hlala kufutshane kangangoko kukhuselekile kwicala lasekhohlo kwaye ungakhawulezisi de sidlule
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi kufuneka uhlale ngokukhuselekileyo kufutshane necala lasekhohlo kwaye ungakhawulezisi de isithuthi esidlulayo sidlule.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.45 — do not pass near a summit, curve or other restricted-view place where passing could create a hazard

en.question: Should you overtake by moving into the path of possible oncoming traffic near a crest or curve where your view is restricted?
options: Yes, if you sound the horn
Yes, if you are in a hurry
en.explanation: You should not overtake where a crest, curve or other restricted view could make passing hazardous to oncoming traffic.

af.question: Moet jy verbysteek deur in die pad van moontlike aankomende verkeer te beweeg naby 'n kruin of draai waar jou uitsig beperk is?
options: Ja, as jy die toeter gebruik
af.explanation: Jy moet nie verbysteek waar 'n kruin, draai of ander beperkte uitsig verbysteek gevaarlik vir aankomende verkeer kan maak nie.

xh.question: Ngaba kufuneka udlule ngokungena kwindlela enokusetyenziswa zizithuthi eziza ngaphambili kufutshane nencopho okanye igophe apho ukubona kwakho kuthintelwe?
xh.explanation: Akufanele udlule apho incopho, igophe okanye enye indawo enokuthintela ukubona inokwenza ukudlula kube yingozi kwizithuthi eziza ngaphambili.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.52 — cell phones

en.question: May you drive or ride on a public road while holding a mobile phone or other communication device in your hand?
options: Yes, if traffic is moving slowly
Yes, if you use only one hand
en.explanation: The learner manual states that a driver or rider may not hold a cellular or mobile telephone or other communication device while driving or riding on a public road.

af.question: Mag jy op 'n openbare pad bestuur of ry terwyl jy 'n selfoon of ander kommunikasietoestel in jou hand hou?
options: Ja, as jy net een hand gebruik
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal dat 'n bestuurder of ryer nie 'n selfoon of ander kommunikasietoestel mag vashou terwyl hy of sy op 'n openbare pad bestuur of ry nie.

xh.question: Ngaba ungakwazi ukuqhuba okanye ukukhwela kwindlela kawonke-wonke ubambe ifowuni ephathwayo okanye esinye isixhobo sonxibelelwano ngesandla?
options: Ewe, ukuba usebenzisa isandla esinye kuphela
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuba umqhubi okanye umkhweli akavumelekanga ukubamba ifowuni ephathwayo okanye esinye isixhobo sonxibelelwano xa eqhuba okanye ekhwele kwindlela kawonke-wonke.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.53 — pedestrians right of way at pedestrian crossings

en.question: What must a driver or rider do for a pedestrian who is crossing the roadway within a pedestrian crossing?
options: Yield right of way and slow down or stop if necessary
Sound the horn and continue at the same speed
Pass in front of the pedestrian if there is enough space
en.explanation: The learner manual requires drivers and riders to yield right of way and slow down or stop if necessary for a pedestrian using a pedestrian crossing.

af.question: Wat moet 'n bestuurder of ryer doen vir 'n voetganger wat die rybaan binne 'n voetgangeroorgang oorsteek?
options: Gee voorrang en verminder spoed of stop indien nodig
Gebruik die toeter en hou dieselfde spoed
Ry voor die voetganger verby as daar genoeg plek is
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding vereis dat bestuurders en ryers voorrang aan 'n voetganger by 'n voetgangeroorgang gee en stadiger ry of stop indien nodig.

xh.question: Kufuneka umqhubi okanye umkhweli enze ntoni kumhambi ngeenyawo owela indlela ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo?
options: Mnike ilungelo lokudlula uze ucothe okanye ume xa kuyimfuneko
Sebenzisa ihorn uze uqhubeke ngesantya esifanayo
Dlula phambi kwakhe ukuba kukho indawo eyaneleyo
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ifuna abaqhubi nabakhweli banike umhambi ngeenyawo ilungelo lokudlula baze bacothe okanye beme xa kuyimfuneko kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.53 — do not pass a vehicle stopped at a pedestrian crossing

en.question: If a vehicle has stopped at a pedestrian crossing, may you pass that stopped vehicle?
options: Yes, if you cannot see a pedestrian
Yes, if your lane looks clear
en.explanation: The learner manual says another driver or rider may not pass a vehicle that has stopped at a pedestrian crossing.

af.question: As 'n voertuig by 'n voetgangeroorgang gestop het, mag jy daardie stilstaande voertuig verbysteek?
options: Ja, as jy geen voetganger kan sien nie
Ja, as jou baan skoon lyk
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê 'n ander bestuurder of ryer mag nie 'n voertuig verbysteek wat by 'n voetgangeroorgang gestop het nie.

xh.question: Ukuba isithuthi simile kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo, ngaba ungadlula kweso sithuthi simileyo?
options: Ewe, ukuba umzila wakho ubonakala ucacile
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi omnye umqhubi okanye umkhweli akavumelekanga ukudlula kwisithuthi esimileyo kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.15 — hooter use only when necessary for safety

en.question: When may you use the hooter of a vehicle?
options: When it is necessary for safety
Whenever you want another driver to move faster
en.explanation: The learner manual says the hooter may be used only when its use is necessary for safety.

af.question: Wanneer mag jy die toeter van 'n voertuig gebruik?
options: Wanneer dit vir veiligheid nodig is
Wanneer jy wil hê 'n ander bestuurder moet vinniger ry
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê die toeter mag slegs gebruik word wanneer dit vir veiligheid nodig is.

xh.question: Ungayisebenzisa nini ihorn yesithuthi?
options: Nanini na ufuna omnye umqhubi ahambe ngokukhawuleza
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi ihorn mayisetyenziswe kuphela xa iyimfuneko ngenxa yokhuseleko.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.16 — emergency vehicle sounding siren and displaying warning lights

en.question: What must you do when an emergency vehicle is sounding a siren and displaying emergency warning lights?
options: Give it immediate right of way
Speed up so you stay ahead of it
en.explanation: The learner manual requires drivers and riders to give immediate right of way to an emergency vehicle sounding a siren and displaying emergency warning lights.

af.question: Wat moet jy doen wanneer 'n noodvoertuig 'n sirene gebruik en noodwaarskuwingsligte vertoon?
options: Versnel sodat jy voor dit bly
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding vereis dat bestuurders en ryers onmiddellik voorrang gee aan 'n noodvoertuig wat 'n sirene gebruik en noodwaarskuwingsligte vertoon.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni xa isithuthi senkonzo kaxakeka sisebenzisa isirena kwaye sibonisa izibane zesilumkiso?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ifuna abaqhubi nabakhweli banike ngoko nangoko ilungelo lokudlula kwisithuthi senkonzo kaxakeka esisebenzisa isirena nezibane zesilumkiso.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.14.2 — service brake, parking brake and emergency brake

en.question: Which braking equipment must a light motor vehicle used on a public road have in good working order?
options: A service brake, parking brake and emergency brake
en.explanation: The learner manual states that a light motor vehicle must have a service brake, parking brake and emergency brake in good working order. The parking and emergency brake may be the same brake.

af.question: Watter remtoerusting moet 'n ligte motorvoertuig wat op 'n openbare pad gebruik word in goeie werkende toestand hê?
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal dat 'n ligte motorvoertuig 'n diensrem, parkeerrem en noodrem in goeie werkende toestand moet hê. Die parkeer- en noodrem kan dieselfde rem wees.

xh.question: Zeziphi izixhobo zokuqhobosha ekufuneka isithuthi esilula esisetyenziswa kwindlela kawonke-wonke sibe nazo zisebenza kakuhle?
options: Ibrake yenkonzo, ibrake yokupaka kunye nebrake kaxakeka
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuba isithuthi esilula kufuneka sibe nebrake yenkonzo, ibrake yokupaka kunye nebrake kaxakeka ezisebenza kakuhle. Ibrake yokupaka kunye nebrake kaxakeka zinokuba yibrake enye.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road — driving signals: indicate intention to change direction, reduce speed or stop

en.question: When must you give a clear driving signal to other road users?
options: Before changing direction, reducing speed or stopping
Only when another driver sounds a hooter
en.explanation: The learner manual requires a clear signal of your intention before changing direction, reducing speed or stopping.

af.question: Wanneer moet jy 'n duidelike bestuursein aan ander padgebruikers gee?
options: Voordat jy van rigting verander, spoed verminder of stop
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding vereis 'n duidelike sein van jou voorneme voordat jy van rigting verander, spoed verminder of stop.

xh.question: Kufuneka unike nini abanye abasebenzisi bendlela uphawu olucacileyo lokuqhuba?
options: Phambi kokutshintsha icala, ukunciphisa isantya okanye ukuma
Kuphela xa omnye umqhubi esebenzisa ihorn
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ifuna uphawu olucacileyo lwenjongo yakho phambi kokutshintsha icala, ukunciphisa isantya okanye ukuma.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road — turning at an intersection: left turn

en.question: Before turning left at an intersection, where should you position your vehicle when it is safe to do so?
options: As close as possible to the left side of the road
As close as possible to the right side of the road
In the centre of the road
en.explanation: Before turning left, the learner manual says to indicate in good time and keep as close as safely possible to the left side of the road.

af.question: Waar moet jy jou voertuig plaas voordat jy links by 'n kruising draai, wanneer dit veilig is om dit te doen?
options: So na as moontlik aan die linkerkant van die pad
So na as moontlik aan die regterkant van die pad
In die middel van die pad
af.explanation: Voordat jy links draai, sê die leerderhandleiding jy moet betyds aandui en so veilig moontlik naby die linkerkant van die pad hou.

xh.question: Phambi kokujika ngasekhohlo kwisiphambuka, kufuneka usibeke phi isithuthi xa kukhuselekile ukwenza njalo?
options: Kufutshane kangangoko kunokwenzeka kwicala lasekhohlo lendlela
Kufutshane kangangoko kunokwenzeka kwicala lasekunene lendlela
xh.explanation: Phambi kokujika ngasekhohlo, incwadi yomfundi ithi kufuneka ubonise injongo yakho kwangethuba uze uhlale kufutshane kangangoko kukhuselekile kwicala lasekhohlo lendlela.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road — turning at an intersection: right turn and yield to oncoming traffic

en.question: Before turning right at an intersection, what must you do about traffic approaching from ahead?
options: Yield right of way and turn only when it is clear and safe
Turn first because you are already at the intersection
Sound the hooter and turn immediately
en.explanation: Before turning right, the learner manual says to indicate in good time, yield to traffic approaching from ahead and turn only when it is clear and safe.

af.question: Wat moet jy doen met verkeer wat van voor af nader voordat jy regs by 'n kruising draai?
options: Gee voorrang en draai slegs wanneer dit oop en veilig is
Draai eerste omdat jy reeds by die kruising is
af.explanation: Voordat jy regs draai, sê die leerderhandleiding jy moet betyds aandui, voorrang gee aan verkeer wat van voor af nader en slegs draai wanneer dit oop en veilig is.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni kwizithuthi ezisondela ngaphambili phambi kokujika ngasekunene kwisiphambuka?
options: Zinike ilungelo lokudlula uze ujike kuphela xa indlela icacile kwaye ikhuselekile
Sebenzisa ihorn uze ujike ngoko nangoko
xh.explanation: Phambi kokujika ngasekunene, incwadi yomfundi ithi kufuneka ubonise injongo yakho kwangethuba, unike indlela kwizithuthi ezisondela ngaphambili uze ujike kuphela xa kucacile kwaye kukhuselekile.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.56 — stopping on a freeway

en.question: When may you stop a vehicle on a freeway?
options: Only when directed by a road sign or traffic officer, in a designated stopping area, or for a reason beyond your control
Whenever you want to check your phone
Whenever you want to rest on the shoulder
en.explanation: The learner manual says stopping on a freeway is allowed only when directed by a sign or traffic officer, in a designated stopping or parking area, or for a reason beyond your control.

af.question: Wanneer mag jy 'n voertuig op 'n snelweg stop?
options: Slegs wanneer 'n padteken of verkeersbeampte dit vereis, in 'n aangewese stopgebied, of om 'n rede buite jou beheer
Wanneer jy jou selfoon wil nagaan
Wanneer jy op die skouer wil rus
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê stop op 'n snelweg is slegs toegelaat wanneer 'n teken of verkeersbeampte dit vereis, in 'n aangewese stop- of parkeergebied, of om 'n rede buite jou beheer.

xh.question: Ungasima nini isithuthi kuhola wendlela?
options: Kuphela xa uphawu lwendlela okanye igosa lezendlela likuyalela, kwindawo emiselweyo yokuma, okanye ngenxa yesizathu esingaphaya kolawulo lwakho
Nanini na ufuna ukuphumla ecaleni kwendlela
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi ukuma kuhola wendlela kuvumelekile kuphela xa uphawu okanye igosa lezendlela likuyalela, kwindawo emiselweyo yokuma okanye yokupaka, okanye ngenxa yesizathu esingaphaya kolawulo lwakho.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.56 — allow a vehicle ahead to merge from an on-ramp

en.question: On a freeway, what should you do when you notice a vehicle in front of you trying to merge from an on-ramp?
options: Allow the vehicle to merge in front of you
Accelerate to block the vehicle from merging
Move closer so there is no gap
en.explanation: The learner manual says that when a vehicle ahead is trying to merge from an on-ramp, you should allow it to merge in front of you.

af.question: Wat moet jy op 'n snelweg doen wanneer jy sien dat 'n voertuig voor jou vanaf 'n oprit probeer invoeg?
options: Laat die voertuig voor jou invoeg
Versnel om te keer dat die voertuig invoeg
Ry nader sodat daar geen gaping is nie
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê dat wanneer 'n voertuig voor jou vanaf 'n oprit probeer invoeg, jy dit voor jou moet laat invoeg.

xh.question: Kufuneka wenze ntoni kuhola wendlela xa ubona isithuthi esiphambi kwakho sizama ukungena sisuka kwindlela yokungena?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi xa isithuthi esiphambi kwakho sizama ukungena sisuka kwindlela yokungena, kufuneka usivumele singene phambi kwakho.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.59 — crossing or entering a public road

en.question: When may you cross or enter a public road?
options: Only when there is enough clear distance to do so without obstructing or endangering traffic
As soon as your front wheels reach the roadway
Whenever another vehicle flashes its headlights
en.explanation: The learner manual says you may cross or enter a public road only when you can do so safely without obstructing or endangering other traffic.

af.question: Wanneer mag jy 'n openbare pad oorsteek of binnegaan?
options: Slegs wanneer daar genoeg oop afstand is om dit te doen sonder om verkeer te hinder of in gevaar te stel
Sodra jou voorwiele die rybaan bereik
Wanneer 'n ander voertuig sy ligte flits
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding sê jy mag 'n openbare pad slegs oorsteek of binnegaan wanneer jy dit veilig kan doen sonder om ander verkeer te hinder of in gevaar te stel.

xh.question: Ungayiwela okanye ungene nini kwindlela kawonke-wonke?
options: Kuphela xa kukho umgama ocacileyo owaneleyo ukuze wenze njalo ngaphandle kokuthintela okanye ukubeka ezinye izithuthi emngciphekweni
Nje ukuba amavili angaphambili afike endleleni
Nanini na esinye isithuthi sikukhanyisela izibane
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ithi ungawela okanye ungene kwindlela kawonke-wonke kuphela xa unokwenza njalo ngokukhuselekileyo ngaphandle kokuthintela okanye ukubeka ezinye izithuthi emngciphekweni.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.49 — reversing only when it can be done safely

en.question: When may you reverse a vehicle on a public road?
options: Only when it can be done safely
Whenever your hazard lights are on
Whenever another driver waits for you
en.explanation: The learner manual states that a vehicle may be reversed only when this can be done safely.

af.question: Wanneer mag jy 'n voertuig op 'n openbare pad agteruit ry?
options: Slegs wanneer dit veilig gedoen kan word
Wanneer 'n ander bestuurder vir jou wag
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding bepaal dat 'n voertuig slegs agteruit gery mag word wanneer dit veilig gedoen kan word.

xh.question: Ungasibuyisela nini isithuthi umva kwindlela kawonke-wonke?
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuba isithuthi singabuyiselwa umva kuphela xa kunokwenziwa ngokukhuselekileyo.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.49 — driver/rider must retain complete control and full view of roadway and traffic ahead

en.question: What must a driver or rider be able to maintain while the vehicle is moving?
options: Complete control of the vehicle and a full view of the roadway and traffic ahead
A view only through the rear-view mirror
One hand free for another task
en.explanation: The learner manual requires the driver or rider to keep complete control of the vehicle and a full view of the roadway and traffic ahead.

af.question: Wat moet 'n bestuurder of ryer kan behou terwyl die voertuig beweeg?
options: Volledige beheer oor die voertuig en 'n volle uitsig oor die pad en verkeer vorentoe
Een hand vry vir 'n ander taak
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding vereis dat die bestuurder of ryer volledige beheer oor die voertuig en 'n volle uitsig oor die pad en verkeer vorentoe behou.

xh.question: Kufuneka umqhubi okanye umkhweli akwazi ukugcina ntoni ngexesha isithuthi sihamba?
options: Ulawulo olupheleleyo lwesithuthi kunye nombono opheleleyo wendlela nezithuthi ezingaphambili
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ifuna umqhubi okanye umkhweli agcine ulawulo olupheleleyo lwesithuthi kunye nombono opheleleyo wendlela nezithuthi ezingaphambili.

source.locator: NaTIS Rules of the Road v1.01 §6.48 — no stopping on right-hand side facing oncoming traffic

en.question: May you stop on the right-hand side of the roadway facing oncoming traffic?
options: Yes, if you keep the engine running
Yes, if you stop for less than one minute
en.explanation: The learner manual lists stopping on the right-hand side of the roadway facing oncoming traffic as prohibited.

af.question: Mag jy aan die regterkant van die rybaan stop terwyl jy aankomende verkeer in die gesig staar?
options: Ja, as die enjin aan bly
Ja, as jy minder as een minuut stop
af.explanation: Die leerderhandleiding noem stop aan die regterkant van die rybaan met jou voertuig na aankomende verkeer gerig as verbode.

xh.question: Ngaba ungema kwicala lasekunene lendlela ujonge izithuthi eziza ngakuwe?
options: Ewe, ukuba ume ngaphantsi komzuzu omnye
xh.explanation: Incwadi yomfundi ichaza ukuba ukuma kwicala lasekunene lendlela ujonge izithuthi eziza ngakuwe akuvumelekanga.
